Maximum Number of Files to Track.displayName: Maximum Number of Files to Track

properties.clean_data:
SELECT 
    customer_id, 
    MAX(customer_name) AS customer_name, 
    MAX(email) AS email, 
    MAX(address) AS address, 
    MAX(phone) AS phone
FROM FLOWFILE
WHERE email IS NOT NULL AND email <> ''
GROUP BY customer_id
